import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top products by total sales
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
top_products = product_sales.head(8)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(top_products)), top_products.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(top_products)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(top_products)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(top_products.index)
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top Products by Total Sales', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].bar_label(axes[0, 0].containers[0], fmt='$%.0f', padding=3)

# 2. Sales by age group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_age = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                          colors=colors_age, startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Sales by payment method
payment_sales = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = axes[0, 2].bar(range(len(payment_sales)), payment_sales.values, 
                      color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(payment_sales)))
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(range(len(payment_sales)))
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(payment_sales.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sales by Payment Method', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].bar_label(bars, fmt='$%.0f', padding=3)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in sales
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels_takeaway = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#2E86AB', '#A23B72']
wedges2, texts2, autotexts2 = axes[1, 0].pie(takeaway_sales.values, labels=labels_takeaway, 
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_takeaway, startangle=90)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts2:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Sales by product size
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
sizes_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = size_sales.reindex(sizes_order)
colors_size = ['#F18F01', '#048BA8', '#2E4057']
bars2 = axes[1, 1].bar(range(len(size_sales)), size_sales.values, color=colors_size)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(size_sales)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(size_sales.index)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sales by Product Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].bar_label(bars2, fmt='$%.0f', padding=3)

# 6. Hourly sales pattern
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 2].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
                color='#2E4057', markersize=8)
axes[1, 2].fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='#048BA8')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
